A very long time ago, Thunder and Lightning lived in a village in Africa. Whenever Lightning was mad, he would burn everything in front of him. When this happened, Thunder would shout at him in her loud, booming voice. Hace muchísimo tiempo, Trueno y Relámpago vivían entre la gente en una aldea de África.
